fine_lines.title: wind / windy, sun / sunny
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wind و sun و snow و rain أسماء. لنصف الطقس نضيف y فتصبح صفات: windy, sunny, snowy, rainy. نقول: It is sunny (وليس It is sun).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Wind, sun, snow and rain are nouns. Add -y to make adjectives for the weather: windy, sunny, snowy, rainy. Say "It is sunny", not "It is sun".

fine_lines.title: hot vs warm, cold vs cool
fine_lines.explanation_ar: من الأعلى حرارة إلى الأدنى: hot (حار) ← warm (دافئ) ← cool (منعش) ← cold (بارد). warm و cool غالبًا لطيفان.
fine_lines.explanation_en: From high to low: hot → warm → cool → cold. Warm and cool are usually pleasant.

grammar.title: Talking about the weather: It is + adjective
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) في الإنجليزية لا بد للجملة من فاعل، فنستخدم It للطقس.
٢) It is + صفة: It is cold. It is sunny.
٣) يمكن جمع صفتين بـ and: It is warm and sunny.
٤) نقول It's اختصارًا لـ It is.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) An English sentence needs a subject, so we use It for the weather.
2) It is + adjective: It is cold. It is sunny.
3) Join two adjectives with and: It is warm and sunny.
4) It's = It is.
examples: It is warm and sunny in summer.

grammar.title: Questions and negatives: Is it ...? / It is not ...
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) للسؤال نقدّم is: Is it cold?
٢) الإجابة: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
٣) للنفي نضيف not بعد is: It is not windy = It isn't windy.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) For a question, put is first: Is it cold?
2) Answers: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
3) For the negative, add not after is: It is not windy = It isn't windy.
examples: Is it sunny? Yes, it is.
Is it snowy? No, it isn't.
